plugins { id 'java'; id 'application' }
group = 'demo'
repositories { mavenCentral() }
dependencies {
    implementation 'org.apache.commons:commons-lang3:3.14.0'
    testImplementation platform("org.junit:junit-bom:5.10.0")
}
tasks.named('test') { useJUnitPlatform(); testLogging { events "passed", "failed" } }
def f = { String s = "x", int n -> "${s}" * n }
class Robot { String name; def move(cmds) { cmds.each { c -> switch (c) { case 'A': break; default: throw new IllegalArgumentException() } } } }
application { mainClass = 'demo.Main' }
